LanguageData.MooGirl.CourierContactLetterText: A mega corporation courier is approaching from the edge of the map. He has not opened fire, but he looks extremely nervous. You can send a colonist to negotiate with him.
LanguageData.MooGirl.CourierAlreadyResolved: This courier can no longer negotiate.
LanguageData.MooGirl.CourierDialogText: The mega corporation courier watches you nervously, one hand never leaving his weapon.\n\n\"I'm just a delivery worker. The ship went down, the cargo is gone, and the company will not listen to excuses. If you want the goods, let me drop the diary and keys I am carrying, then I leave right now. Do not force me to shoot. I do not want this reaching the company level either.\"
LanguageData.MooGirl.CourierItemsDroppedMessage: The corporate courier dropped his carried items and is leaving.
LanguageData.MooGirl.CourierFightMessage: The corporate courier draws his weapon. This clash will not change your relationship with the mega corporation.
LanguageData.MooGirl.LetterWandererJoins: A {PAWN_title} named {PAWN_nameDef} has arrived here, wishing to join the colony.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] claims to have nowhere else to go and is willing to contribute. {PAWN_objective} won't leave voluntarily; you can choose to refuse {PAWN_objective} and send {PAWN_objective} away. However, your colonists will feel uneasy about turning away someone in need.
LanguageData.MooGirl.OpeningPodCrash:
Two transport pods have crash-landed nearby, each carrying an escaped Mugirl slave.
They just escaped from a mega corporation's slave transport ship- whether due to ship malfunction, attack, or some other means remains unknown. The escape has left them utterly exhausted, and the tightly bound slave restraints on their bodies silently record the pain and submission they endured under the mega corporation's tyranny. The impact has also left {PAWN_pronoun} severely injured.

Now they have nowhere to go. If you choose to rescue them, they will join your colony. Will you give these two pitiful yet lovely escapees a chance at freedom and a new life?
LanguageData.MooGirl.OpeningPodCrash_Child: Among them, {PAWN_nameDef} is a {AGE}-year-old child who has just escaped from a slave caravan and is completely alone.
LanguageData.MooGirl.OpeningPodCrash_Factionless: Among them, [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't belong to any faction. You can choose to rescue [PAWN_objective], hoping [PAWN_pronoun] will freely join your colony, or you can choose to capture [PAWN_objective] to recruit or enslave [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.MooGirl.OpeningPodCrash_Hostile: Among them, {PAWN_nameDef} comes from the hostile faction {PAWN_factionName}. You can capture [PAWN_objective] to recruit or enslave [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.MooGirl.OpeningPodCrash_NonHostile: {PAWN_nameDef} comes from {PAWN_factionName}. If you rescue [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_pronoun] will improve relations between your factions when [PAWN_pronoun] returns.\n\nYou can also capture [PAWN_objective] to recruit or enslave [PAWN_objective], but this will anger [PAWN_possessive] faction.
